title: Unit Event — Popping in My Heart! — Episode5 First Time Learning That Trick

meta.Episode: Episode5 — First Time Learning That Trick
meta.Event Outline: Emu takes part in a discussion with her brothers regarding future operations of the park. However, each idea she puts forth comes up against issues of feasibility, leaving her determined to educate herself. That's when she gets the news of an opportunity to visit Mr. Riley's park...

rows.Line: Riley Dream Park
“Blue World” area

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've entered the “Blue World” area.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, that movie's about a dolphin that sets out into the ocean to find its parents.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right.
Most of these rides and attractions all seem to be ocean themed too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We don't have time to look around right now since we still have to get her to the care center... Or so I thought...

rows.Speaker: Lost Girl
rows.Line: So cute!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What do we do?!
She must really like this dolphin because she isn't letting go of its statue!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She seems pretty happy for a kid who got separated...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. She must like this area quite a bit if she's forgotten about her current situation, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I understand how she feels. I mean, what child wouldn't be excited about seeing this area?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I remember Saki getting lost a few times like this while trying to have fun like our little one here...

rows.Speaker: Lost Girl
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, where are you going?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?! Is that the ocean...?!
Whoa, it really is!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Emu, what's wrong?!
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Look, you guys! It's the ocean!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? She's right...!
Wait, this park extends out into the sea...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, not quite. It looks like the sea, but it's definitely manmade. They've even built an impressive beach to go along with it...

rows.Speaker: Lost Girl
rows.Line: This is Blue's house!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
House? Oh, now I remember...!
This looks just like the place where the dolphin from “Blue World” lives!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is incredible... They went this far to bring everything from that movie into our world?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can't believe they made it so the water forms waves since it doesn't look like it's open to the public like a wave pool or something, you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, immersion must've been a top priority for them here. This beach alone lets you dive right into the story's narrative.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How do you think they did all this, you guys?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What do you mean, “How?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm talking about how they were able to do really big things like building a whole ocean and stuff. I can't figure out why they're able to do this but we aren't...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose it begins with how realistic the prospects of building an ocean such as this are.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How realistic?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I see what you mean... Like whether or not it's actually safe to build an artificial lake?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that's part of it.
A piece of land would need to be supported in some way if it's unable to handle such a drastic change. But there's also...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Their budget...
Projects like these will require a considerable amount of resources to even get off the ground.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This may be one of the most famous theme parks in the world, but even they will only have a finite amount of resources.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I see...!
Jot... Jot... Jot...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Why are you writing all this down?

rows.Speaker: Lost Girl
rows.Line: Look!

rows.Speaker: Lost Girl
rows.Line: A forest!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
W-Wah!
It's not safe to tug on people like that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Again?!
Where's she taking us now?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She said, “There's a forest over there!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
A forest?
Is she talking about the “Jungle Music” area...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We can't let her get lost again!
After them!
“Jungle Music” area

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...!
Finally... We caught up!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...!! Look at all the trees!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This movie's about a plane crashing into a jungle and making their way back to civilization after becoming friends with the animals there, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Correct.
Not only that, this area also seems to have an immersive quality to it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But these trees are imitations...
And yet, it feels like we've wandered into a real jungle for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?!
Hang on. Is that tree...?
A roller coaster...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, apparently.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on the research I did before arriving here, I believe it's supposed to represent the movie's final scene where they fall from the tallest tree in the jungle.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, see how they're falling backwards? It's as if you, the rider, are the protagonist being pushed off the tree by your enemy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I see...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But that thing goes really high up.
Wouldn't that scare most kids?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree.
It may be too much for...

rows.Speaker: Lost Girl
rows.Line: Let's ride the roller coaster!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
You wanna go on that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?! Are you sure?!
We really should get you to the center as soon as possible...

rows.Speaker: Lost Girl
rows.Line: I wanna ride the roller coaster!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... I've seen this look before.
Saki always made the same face whenever she really wanted to go on something.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. And there aren't many people in line right now. Why don't we take this opportunity to go on it?
se_event_nikkori_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait! No! Hold on!!
This is higher than I thought!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-We have to go down backwards too...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We're so high up!
Is our little one gonna be okay? You sure it won't scare her too much...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
...
Alright, here we go!
se_event_nikkori_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: N-Nooooo!!
se_event_nikkori_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-It wasn't bad at all...?!

rows.Speaker: Lost Girl
rows.Line: That was fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Just as I suspected...
She seems to have enjoyed herself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The drop on this ride definitely looks high, but in reality, it was much gentler and not as big a drop as one would expect.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's not to say that it wasn't thrilling or anything. They did a wonderful job of building up everyone's suspense prior to the initial drop.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Every park has some kind of roller coaster that's meant for kids...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you getting to experience the story from a movie while riding a fun roller coaster like this was really something else.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(That's amazing...!
It's like everything here's designed to make everyone smile...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, that must be the Compass Center...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We need to hurry, Emu. This girl's parents might be waiting for her there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right!
